name: Lafourche Parish, LA
findings: Lafourche Parish has 194 nonprofit organizations. 60 of them (31%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 50 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (24% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, Lafourche Parish has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Religious organizations that list no opportunities
observations.text: 15 religious organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity on their websites. Many may still offer them without saying so online, or have no website at all.

confidence.text: Based on 15 organizations here; 46% of all organizations here have no identified type.
